lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular clusters arranged in a semi-regular grid pattern. Individual nodes are organized into vertical columns posterior to the gill slits, with approximately 4-5 visible horizontal rows of varying intensity.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal lines of similar luminance; high-intensity circular blobs are positioned precisely at these grid-like intersection coordinates.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent linear feature extending horizontally across the upper third of the visible flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical luminance gradient transitioning from light (dorsal) to shadow (ventral).

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse distribution of small, high-luminance pixel clusters located within the silhouette of the first dorsal fin, showing lower density compared to the lateral flank.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin exhibits a high spatial frequency of small, high-intensity spots that are significantly smaller in diameter and more densely packed than the primary constellations on the mid-lateral flank.
